operationName: Ebola PHEIC Response — 2026 Bundibugyo Outbreak, DRC & Uganda
heroHeadline: Uganda Tightens Borders as Ebola Spreads to Kenya
heroSubtitle: Uganda has tightened border screening with DRC after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola death on 12 October 2026, raising cross-border transmission concerns across East Africa. The Bundibugyo outbreak has surpassed 8,700 cases and 4,200 deaths.
footerNote: Data sourced from DRC Ministry of Health (MSANTE) situation reports, ECDC outbreak tracker, WHO Disease Outbreak News, Africa CDC statements, Uganda Ministry of Health, CDC Ebola Situation Summary, MSF, AP, AFP, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, Healio, Reuters, and UN News. Case counts are rapidly evolving.
